title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: A student chats with your makerspace assistant on Monday and returns on Friday in a new session. Your program saves nothing and loads nothing between the two sessions. What does the model know on Friday about Monday's chat?

options.text: Everything, because the model stores each conversation it has
Nothing, because Friday's context starts without any trace of it
A short summary, which the model writes for itself on Monday
Only the last question, which a large window can keep alive

items.stem: For one request, the start of the context (instructions, tool descriptions and the question) is 2,000 tokens. The model's first call returns a tool request of 100 tokens. The tool result is 600 tokens. A second call then writes the final answer. Counting only the input the model reads on each call, how many input tokens were read in total across both calls?
Your assistant must answer questions from a 400-page set of machine manuals, and each model call costs money. Which design keeps the cost per question lowest while still answering from the manuals?

options.text: Paste all 400 pages into the context at the start of every request
Retrieve only the few passages that match the question, and add those
Paste in the table of contents and trust the model to know the rest
Ask the student to paste the pages that they think are relevant

items.stem: Give one reason to keep irrelevant text out of an agent's context even when it would fit inside the context window.
A student passes laser cutter training today. In one or two sentences, how can the assistant know this at that student's next visit next week?
